runbill v0.4.0

- `--compare`: week-over-week diff. Compares the window (`--days N` / `--since DATE`) with the equal-length window right before it — billed minutes and cost per workflow and job, change in $ and %, biggest increase first; `new` / `gone` rows marked. Works with `--by`, in `runbill org`, `runbill demo --compare`, and every format.
- `--fail-increase PCT` (with `--compare`): exit 3 if total cost rose by more than PCT percent — a CI gate for cost regressions.
- Action: new `compare` and `fail-increase` inputs; the job summary shows the diff.
- GitHub API calls retry transient failures (HTTP 500/502/503/504, secondary rate limits, connection resets and timeouts) up to 3 times with exponential backoff, honouring `Retry-After`.

Action: `uses: Blackman99/runbill@v0.4.0` · Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/runbill@v0.4.0` · Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/runbill/docs/
